# eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves the security groups available to Eon in a region of an AWS restore account. Use this data source to select security group IDs for an EC2 `eon_restore_job`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List the security groups available to Eon in a restore account region
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups" "all" {
  restore_account_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
  region             = "us-east-1"
}

# Example: Narrow security groups to a single VPC
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups" "vpc" {
  restore_account_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  vpc_id             = "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"
}

output "restore_security_group_ids" {
  description = "IDs of the security groups in the VPC"
  value       = [for sg in data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups.vpc.security_groups : sg.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Region where the security groups are located.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.

### Optional

- `subnet_id` (String) Optional ID of the subnet to filter security groups by.
- `vpc_id` (String) Optional ID of the VPC to filter security groups by.

### Read-Only

- `security_groups` (Attributes List) List of security groups available to Eon in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the security group.
- `name` (String) Name of the security group.
- `vpc_id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the VPC the security group is in.
